general.densityHint: Compact tightens list and page padding - useful on small screens or to fit more on one screen.
general.storageHint: Settings and repository records live in a SQLite database in the app data directory and survive restarts.
general.themeNote: The theme is kept in browser local storage because it must be readable synchronously before the first paint; storing it in the database would cause a flash on startup.
general.loadFailedHint: The local database may be unreachable. Retry, and if it keeps failing check the logs.

advanced.logsPolicy: Logs are written to the app data directory, rotate on both a daily and a 10MB threshold, and are kept for 7 days. Tokens and passwords are stripped before writing, and nothing is ever uploaded.

appearance.themeHint: Applies immediately and is remembered; System follows the OS appearance.
